newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Silver Grant in Wuhan toll bridge venture.
newsitem.headline: Silver Grant in Wuhan toll bridge venture.

text.p: Silver Grant International Industries Ltd said it has agreed to form a joint venture which will indirectly participate in the construction and management of a toll bridge in Wuhan, in China's Hubei province.

The company said in a statement on Monday that it has formed a 40-percent owned joint venture company, China Infra-Structure Investment Ltd, with Chinese partners China Road and Bridge Group (H.K.) Ltd and Zhen Hua Engineering Co Ltd. They will hold 32 percent and 28 percent respectively in the venture.

China Infra-Structure has also agreed to set up a 50-50 joint venture in China with Wuhan Bai Sha Zhou Bridge Co Ltd, a Chinese state-owned enterprise, to build, manage and operate the Wuhan Bai Sha Zhou Bridge and connecting junction road.
The joint venture Wuhan Baishazhou Bridge Co Ltd would have registered capital of HK$465 million and invest HK1.86 billion in the 3.6 kilometres toll road project.
Silver Grant's managing director Gao Jianmin said the investment would further diversify the company's investments in China and generate steady income and cash flow.
China Road (H.K.) is a construction and civil engineering firm wholly-owned by China Road And Bridge Corp. Zhen Hua is the Hong Kong representative of China Harbour Engineering Co.
